title: Classification of Coastal & Arid Features
subject: Geography
description: A classification diagram defining and differentiating between straits, canals, deserts, and seas based on their natural/artificial origin and key characteristics.
mermaidCode:
graph TD
    A[Geographical Features] --> B{Water Bodies & Landforms}
    B --> C[Water Bodies]
    B --> D[Landforms]
    C --> C1[Strait]
    C --> C2[Canal]
    C --> C3[Sea]
    D --> D1[Desert]
    C1 -- Natural --> ConnectsTwoLargerBodies(Connects two larger water bodies)
    C2 -- Artificial --> NavigationIrrigationHydroelectric(Navigation, Irrigation, Hydro-electric)
    C3 -- Marginal Part of Ocean --> PartiallyEnclosed(Often partially enclosed by land)
    D1 -- Region --> Less250mmPrecipitation(Receiving < 250mm annual precipitation)
